description: This file is a forward declaration header for the nlohmann::json library, defining templates, classes, and namespace macros related to JSON handling in C++.

classes.name: basic_json
classes.description: Template class for JSON values supporting various container and type options.

classes.name: json_pointer
classes.description: Class representing a JSON Pointer for referencing specific JSON values.

classes.name: ordered_map
classes.description: Template class for a map-like container that preserves insertion order.

classes.name: ordered_json
classes.description: Type alias for basic_json with ordered_map to maintain insertion order.

classes.name: adl_serializer
classes.description: Template struct for default JSON serialization using ADL.

methods.name: json
methods.description: Type alias for basic_json<> representing a JSON object.
